objective: Determine the minimal structural coupling of plus/minus channels within the selected C=PRESENCE, D=CLIP3, A=CLIP2 exchange carrier, without dropping one sign channel or selecting family-specific exceptions from scalar outcomes.

pairFamilies.C: ordered nonnegative pair (C+,C-) with each entry in {0,1}
pairFamilies.D: ordered nonnegative pair (D+,D-) with each entry in {0,1,2,3+}
pairFamilies.A: ordered nonnegative pair (A+,A-) with each entry in {0,1,2+}

couplingModes.name: TOTAL
couplingModes.definition: Retain x+ + x- only; discard direction and within-family imbalance.

couplingModes.name: SIGNED_NET
couplingModes.definition: Retain x+ - x- as a signed integer; preserve net direction but allow opposite changes to cancel.

couplingModes.name: ABS_NET
couplingModes.definition: Retain |x+ - x-|; discard direction but preserve imbalance magnitude.

couplingModes.name: UNORDERED_PAIR
couplingModes.definition: Retain sorted multiset {x+,x-}; discard which channel is plus while preserving both saturated values.

couplingModes.name: SEPARATED
couplingModes.definition: Retain ordered pair (x+,x-) exactly; reconstruction control.

candidateGrid.construction: Complete Cartesian product of the five frozen coupling modes independently assigned to C,D,A.

familyOrder: TOTAL, ABS_NET, and SIGNED_NET are pairwise incomparable
partialOrder.dominance: Candidate X is strictly coarser than Y only when every family mode in X is no finer than the corresponding mode in Y under the frozen familyOrder, with at least one strict relation.
partialOrder.output: Report all Pareto-minimal common-exact grid points; do not impose a total order on incomparable couplings.

structuralProcedure: Start from each frozen EW-RS-076 selected pair signature C+/C- presence, D+/D- CLIP3, A+/A- CLIP2.
Apply the chosen coupling mode independently to the C pair, D pair, and A pair.
Form each OOO triple key as the sorted multiset of its three transformed pair signatures.
Generate all 125 feature catalogs, matched-dependency rows, and structural bases before scalar replay.
Replay scalar residues only after the complete structural grid is frozen.
measurements: which families can discard plus/minus orientation
antiCircularity: The five coupling modes, three families, complete 125-point grid, and partial order are frozen before scalar inspection.
No one-sided channel deletion, sign-specific exception, or outcome-selected coupling is permitted.
The selected EW-RS-076 family saturation and EW-RS-065 matched dependencies are unchanged.
EW-RS-059 PRIMARY 3x6-k4 and BACKUP 5x3-k4 remain sealed.
falsifiers: C=SEPARATED,D=SEPARATED,A=SEPARATED must reproduce EW-RS-076 selected ranks 72,252,14 with zero contradictions.
Any structurally zero candidate residue with nonzero scalar residue is insufficient.
No post-hoc sign-channel rescue is allowed.
nextIfCoupledPasses: Freeze every Pareto-minimal common sign-channel quotient and test small algebraic/circuit functionals on its finite pair alphabet.
nextIfSeparatedRequired: Retain separated channels where required and move directly to outcome-independent circuit reduction without sign-specific coefficient fitting.
interpretationGuards: Plus/minus labels refer to signed structural exchange direction under the frozen pair orientation, not player identity.
A family-level coupling result does not imply upstream game-state sign symmetry.
No Q-A/Q-F, standard-7x6, universal theorem, or center-opening proof follows.
